description: Find a VA-accredited representative to help with a disability claim or appeal. Choose an accredited representative: VSO (Veterans Service Organization) representatives — who help FREE — plus accredited claims agents and accredited attorneys. This tool leads with free options first. Returns representatives filtered by state, city and type. Attorneys/agents may generally charge for review after notice of the initial VA decision, subject to fee rules and a written agreement. Not legal advice; not affiliated with the VA.
